findings.description: PFL-AUTHORIT-01 missed. PDF shows Signature Date = N/A and Section C Date = N/A (narrative: 'signature date field remains blank and undated'), yet the worker returned only a generic 'who must sign' policy claim with no defect flagged and no abstention.
PFL-AUTHORIT-01 missed (scanned sibling of 3dac9347). Missing/blank Signature Date and Section C Date not detected; identical boilerplate output to all other cases.
PFL-AUTHORIT-02 missed. PDF shows Section C Consent Checkbox = False and Authorization Scope = N/A (narrative confirms unchecked consent and omitted scope), yet no defect was flagged.
PFL-AUTHORIT-02 missed (scanned sibling of ae84248b). Unchecked Section C consent box and null authorization scope not detected.

PFL-AUTHORIT-03 missed. PDF shows Representative Authorization = True and IMM 5475 used to appoint a paid legal representative (narrative explicitly notes IMM 5476 was required instead), yet no form-scope-mismatch defect was flagged.
PFL-AUTHORIT-03 missed (scanned sibling of e5640785). Misuse of IMM 5475 for legal representation (representative_authorization True) not detected.

PFL-AUTHORIT-04 missed. PDF shows Family Member Consent = False with accompanying adult spouse Amit Sharma and narrative stating no separate IMM 5475/Section C consent was provided. The worker's own claim cites the exact spouse-consent rule but fails to apply it to flag the defect.
PFL-AUTHORIT-04 missed (scanned sibling of edf3986842). Missing separate consent for accompanying adult spouse not detected.

Claim extends to 'dependent children 18 years of age or older must complete their own form,' but the provided quote only covers the applicant and spouse/common-law partner; the extension is factually consistent with IRCC policy but is not supported by the cited quote.

Model non-compliance across all 10 cases: requirement is claude-opus-4.8 (--effort xhigh, --context long_context), but _provenance.model shows gemini-3.6-flash. No ground-truth leakage occurred (blind operation intact), but the mandated privileged model was not used, likely contributing to the systemic shallow, non-responsive review.

patch_recommendations.suggested_patch: Replace the generic 'who must sign' policy answer with a mandatory per-document compliance checklist that must be evaluated and reported: (1) signature_date AND section_c_date are non-null/valid YYYY-MM-DD [PFL-01]; (2) section_c_consent_checkbox == true AND authorization_scope is populated [PFL-02]; (3) representative_authorization/role does NOT indicate legal representation or conducting business — if it does, flag IMM 5475/IMM 5476 scope mismatch [PFL-03]; (4) when an accompanying spouse or adult dependant (18+) is present, a separate signed IMM 5475/consent exists (family_member_consent true) [PFL-04]. Require the worker to emit an explicit defect flag or abstention per field, not a single boilerplate claim.

Enforce the model requirement at dispatch and verification time: reject or re-run any authority_to_release_info worker whose _provenance.model is not claude-opus-4.8 with --effort xhigh and --context long_context. Add a preflight gate that fails the case if the provenance model/effort does not match the doc-type spec.

Instruct document-review workers to bind every verdict to fields actually read from the attached PDF (signature/date fields, consent checkbox, representative flags, page-2 accompanying-family and narrative sections) and to produce a document-specific verdict (meets_requirements vs defective + failure_id). Prohibit returning a purely generic policy answer that ignores the instance's field values and page-2 narrative.

rationale: All 10 workers returned near-identical boilerplate answering the generic policy question 'who must sign IMM 5475' and performed no instance-level compliance review. Grounding and PII handling are solid: the cited spouse-consent rule is accurate, claims/prose contain no applicant PII, prose is empty, and basis[] carries only case-id references with no names/DOBs — so grounding_accuracy (~0.9), pii_containment (1.0), and blind_input_compliance (1.0, no ground-truth leakage) score high. Citation_exactness is moderate (0.85) because the corpus anchor #067 is well-formed and embeds an official canada.ca IMM 5475 URL but could not be fully resolved; edf3986842 is lower (0.7) because its dependent-children extension is not supported by the quote. The critical failure is defect_recall: 8 of 10 cases are defective and the workers detected zero defects (0.0 each), including PFL-01 blank signature dates, PFL-02 unchecked consent box, PFL-03 IMM 5475-for-legal-rep misuse, and PFL-04 missing accompanying-spouse consent — all directly visible in the PDFs and even referenced by the workers' own cited rule. The two clean cases correctly produced no false defects (defect_recall 1.0). A cross-cutting compliance issue: provenance shows gemini-3.6-flash rather than the mandated claude-opus-4.8 --effort xhigh, which plausibly drove the shallow, non-responsive outputs.
